Finally, use the quadratic formula x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a) to find the solutions.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Next, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues. The corresponding eigenvectors form the principal components. Project the data onto the new feature space. As for the mathematics, it can be complex, but you don't need to understand all the details to use PCA effectively.
